limitations: A predicted structure is not an experimental one. Nothing in this payload was measured, and it must never be pooled with the PDBe deposition counts structures.evidence returns.
pLDDT is the model's own confidence, not its accuracy, and not a measurement of anything. It is least trustworthy on exactly the sequences this lane exists for.

ESMFold runs single-sequence with no MSA and no template. For a sequence with few homologs, accuracy is lower than published benchmark averages, which are dominated by well-represented families. A low pLDDT on a novel pathogen protein is the expected reading, not a defect.

The neighbour count is a burial proxy, not SASA: a count of CB atoms within a radius, with no solvent model, no probe radius and no sidechain packing past CB. It is computed on predicted coordinates and inherits their error, and over a low-pLDDT stretch it carries no information at all.

One monomer, one conformation, in vacuum. No partners, glycans, membrane, ligand or ensemble. For a viral glycoprotein the biological unit is usually a trimer, so a surface scored here as least-buried may be an oligomeric interface that is never solvent-exposed in the assembled particle.
A fragment folded in isolation is not that fragment's fold inside the chain it was cut from, and the 400-residue ceiling forces most full-length glycoproteins to be cut.

This bears on accessibility weakly, as a hypothesis about which residues are exposed in a predicted monomer. It establishes nothing whatever about essentiality, conservation, assay availability, public labels or precedent, and it is not reagent tractability: a confident fold is not evidence that the protein expresses solubly or survives immobilisation.
The ESMFold v1 training corpus has its own cutoff, which this module did not verify. Any claim that a prediction for this pathogen is free of hindsight is unverified here.
The host caches by sequence, so a repeated call is roughly twenty times faster than the first. Only the cold number is a cost a campaign pays.
plddt_scale: 0-100. The endpoint writes pLDDT into the PDB B-factor column on a 0-1 scale; these values are that column multiplied by 100.

exposure_proxy.method: count of other residues whose CB (CA for glycine) lies within 10.0 angstrom. A contact number.
exposure_proxy.caveat: A proxy for burial on predicted coordinates, not a solvent-accessible surface area and not a measurement. Positions are reported only where pLDDT clears the threshold, because a contact number over a low-confidence stretch describes a fold the model did not commit to. A monomer surface is not necessarily exposed in an oligomer.

unverified: Every coordinate, every pLDDT value and every neighbour count. A prediction and a proxy computed on it are model assertions, not measurements, and nothing here was checked against an experiment.
